title: Ranking This Motel's Worst ROOMS 🛏️
description:
This roadside motel has five rooms nobody books, from a bed that's always warm to a phone that knows your full name. Here they are, counted down.

My cousin and I broke down outside at eleven at night. The clerk gave us room one, and there's a comment card on every pillow.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
